text:
nisha_platform: quick heads-up — planning a synthetic load campaign to validate admission backpressure thresholds across eu-west and us-west. aim: verify graceful degradation and cost signal before we change defaults.

alex_devex: 👍 what's the blast profile? sustained or spikes?

nisha_platform: two phases: 1) 30m ramp to target sustained RPS; 2) 10x burst spikes (30s) every 5m for stress windows. target sustained RPS based on current traffic mix ~ 2k rps global. will run against a/b admission configs.

maria_infra: note: eu-west has more p100 pools this week, us-west is on mixed preemptible a100s. cost and eviction risk differ. we should annotate runs per GPU class.

kai_sre: tag me for alerts. I'll temporarily mute noisy PagerDuty rules but keep high-sev. Also we need a kill-switch if tail latency > 5s for >2m.

sam_runtime: proposed admission configs (short):
```
config_a: # conservative
  max_inflight_per_gpu: 4
  queue_depth: 100
  admission_rate_per_gpu: 300 rps

config_b: # aggressive
  max_inflight_per_gpu: 8
  queue_depth: 400
  admission_rate_per_gpu: 700 rps
```
we'll run both in parallel on different pools.

nisha_platform: run plan:
- eu-west: config_a on pool-eu-a100, config_b on pool-eu-p100 (canary)
- us-west: config_a on reserved-dedicated, config_b on burst-preempt
- metric set: p50/p95/p99 latency, adm_reject_rate, queue_len, gpu_util, tokens/sec, cost_est/hr
- dashboards: create ephemeral panels and a compare view

alex_devex: small script for generating traffic:
```bash
# local driver using hey/wrk wrapper
python tools/flood.py --targets 50 --rps 40 --duration 1800 --payload-file samples/chat_batched.json
```
will tag runs with run_id to correlate logs.

maria_infra: cost note: full blast estimate = ~ $110/hr eu-west a100 pool + $60/hr p100 workers (spot). if we keep bursts long we might hit spend cap. suggest setting a $300 budget for the whole campaign.

ops-bot: synthetic-run 1792003480 started by nisha_platform: targets=[eu-west:pool-eu-a100,eu-west:pool-eu-p100,us-west:reserved,us-west:burst] profile=sustained+spikes budget=$300

kai_sre: seeing early signs on staging: admission-controller metrics show queue_depth trending to ~70% on config_b in eu-west within 10m. will watch.

sam_runtime: quick check: add this probe to identify queue head-of-line stalls:
```json
{"probe":"head_latency","sample_window_s":60,"threshold_ms":4000}
```
if avg > threshold then flip config_b -> fail-open (reject more aggressively) and notify.

nisha_platform: good. also add a cost tag so billing export shows run_id. we want per-minute cost to catch surprises.

ops-bot: synthetic-run 1792003560 update: sustained phase reached target rps. adm_reject_rate: eu-west/config_b=2.1%, eu-west/config_a=0.6%, us-west/config_b=3.9%, us-west/config_a=0.8%

maria_infra: interesting — higher rejects in preemptible us-west as expected. we should correlate with eviction logs.

kai_sre: spike test (first burst) scheduled in ~3m. reminder: kill-switch is active and PD muted except sev.

ops-bot: synthetic-run 1792003880 spike-run executed: 30s bursts x3. observed: us-west/config_b queue_len spike to 560, p99 latency 6.2s, rejects climbed to 9.4% during bursts.

sam_runtime: that's above our safety threshold. initiating automatic policy: throttle config_b -> admission_rate_per_gpu -= 40% for 10m.

nisha_platform: keep running but reduce burst frequency. capture full logs and save heap/profile from runtime nodes. we'll need root cause — likely KV cache eviction and slow kernel path on preemptible a100.

maria_infra: pulled kernel traces and GPU metrics. attaching short sample in infra-corp: gpu_mem_pressure high, context-switches spiked when preempts coincided with bursts.

alex_devex: decision proposals:
- default config -> conservative (config_a) for preemptible pools
- aggressive config (config_b) only for reserved/low-eviction pools behind a feature flag
- add auto-shed policy: if adm_reject_rate > 5% or p99>4s then escalate reject_rate and spin up burst-capacity if available

nisha_platform: agreed. action items:
- sam_runtime: codify auto-shed & kill-switch (owner)
- maria_infra: add eviction labels to pool metadata and surface in console (owner)
- kai_sre: run another 1h validation with updated policy (owner)
- alex_devex: add run_id cost export and ephemeral dashboards (owner)

kai_sre: I'll schedule validation tomorrow 08:00 UTC and post a follow-up thread with results.

ops-bot: synthetic-run 1792004515 finished. summary: total run=1h12m, peak RPS=2.1k, total rejects=4.3% global, cost=$275, actions triggered=[auto-shed on us-west/config_b, throttle window applied].

nisha_platform: perfect — thanks everyone. filing a short RFC to make conservative defaults permanent and add a runbook note for synthetic campaigns. ping me for review. :thumbsup:
